title: Taking the Regent's cask of Ironbound oil via the Envoy option drew visible disapproval from all four companions in the same turn (Vell: 'whose furniture you are burning'; Tamsin: 'do not forget whose name goes on it'; Osk: 'I still had to look away'; Lys: 'I hope you know what you traded for it'), yet none of their regard numbers moved from before to after (checked via status), contradicting the game's own stated rule that 'companions judge what you do: their regard opens some doors and closes others.'
where: The Regent's Chambers (Marrowgate) / 'negotiate the terms first (Envoy)'
